AnswerView.description:
One model's answer inside an agreement assessment (term adjudicator 1.1.0): its raw
text as received, and its verdict and reason only if it passed validation.
AnswerView.title: AnswerView

AssessmentView.description:
A local model's judgement about this finding (and, for a pair, one other). Shown
only when the role may see every finding it names. For 1.0.0 (one model) a rejected or
failed answer shows its status and reason codes, never the model's text; for 1.1.0
(agreement) answers holds each model's raw answer, and verdict and reason are the
agreement rule's.
AssessmentView.title: AssessmentView

AssetLive.description: Computed from the ledger at request time, as the caller may see it.
AssetLive.title: AssetLive

AssetStatic.description: Served as written in config/portfolio.toml; nothing here is computed.
AssetStatic.title: AssetStatic

AuditReviewRequested.description:
The trigger of an audit review (phase 3 step 4b): quality.audit_trail_reviewer reads
the ledger from from_seq through through_seq, always below this event's own seq.
AuditReviewRequested.title: AuditReviewRequested

AuditView.description:
The Audit tab: the last audit review and the current audit findings the caller may
see. chain_linkage: intact, broken, or not_reviewed (no completed review yet).
AuditView.title: AuditView

ColumnRule.description: How one heatmap column is banded, read from the agent's config.
ColumnRule.title: ColumnRule

ContainmentCheck.description: One command of a conformance run and what happened to it.
ContainmentCheck.title: ContainmentCheck

ContainmentCheckCompleted.description: A zone's committed policy was checked in a real sandbox (meridian sandbox conformance).
ContainmentCheckCompleted.title: ContainmentCheckCompleted

Decision.description: A human's disposition of a finding.
Decision.title: Decision

Enrollment.description: Cumulative treated subjects by month of first treatment (blinded DM RFSTDTC).
Enrollment.title: Enrollment

Evidence.description:
One measurable fact supporting a finding.

Phase 2 step 4 adds context, all optional (null on events written before it): role
says whether the finding rests on this item (primary) or it only adds context
(supporting); direction is the value against its reference (low, high, or none for a
p value or a count); expected is that reference (the expected count, the median site,
the chance level of a terminal digit, the limit); display is the value as it should
be read, at the precision fixed for its statistic (meridian.agents.rbqm.describe).
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceChangedSince.description:
The primary evidence differs from the finding a person already closed: before and
after are the display values, removed and added the difference.
EvidenceChangedSince.title: EvidenceChangedSince

Finding.description:
Something an agent believes a human should look at.

finding_id is issued by the ledger when the finding is first recorded, so a
finding inside an EventDraft carries finding_id=None.
Finding.title: Finding

FindingAssessment.description:
A model's judgement about one or two findings, by safety.term_adjudicator (phase 3
step 3b): do two event terms describe the same event?

It never changes, closes or supersedes a finding; a person reads it next to them.
candidate: term_mismatch (one sae_term_mismatch finding) or unpaired_pair (an
sae_missing_in_safety_db and a case_without_clinical_sae finding of the same subject
with onsets within the reconciler's window). accepted: the output passed validation,
and only then are verdict and reason recorded. rejected: it failed validation
(reasons say why); nothing of it is shown. error: the call failed or the served model
was not the pinned one (retried on the next pass). Hashes are of the canonical
request body sent and of the raw response body received; model_digest is the digest
Ollama served.

Agreement (1.1.0): answers holds one ModelAnswer per model asked, each with its raw
text, model and digest; model names the models joined by "+", and model_digest and
request_sha256 are left out (each answer has its own). Then the status is error if
any answer is an error, rejected if every answer was rejected, and accepted
otherwise, with the verdict of agreed_verdict and a reason the host writes.
FindingAssessment.title: FindingAssessment

FindingNarrative.description:
A plain-language explanation of one finding, by rbqm.narrator (phase 2 step 3).

The finding itself is never changed. accepted: the model's text passed validation, and
only then are headline and explanation recorded. rejected: it failed validation
(reasons say why). refused: the de-identification check stopped the input; nothing
was sent. error: the call failed (retried on the next pass). Hashes are of the
canonical request body sent and of the raw response body received.
FindingNarrative.title: FindingNarrative

ModelAnswer.description:
One model's answer inside a FindingAssessment of the agreement rule (1.1.0).

text is the raw response content as received (never a reasoning trace), recorded
whether or not it passed validation; verdict and reason only when it did. An error
answer has no text (the call failed, or the served digest was not the pinned one).
ModelAnswer.title: ModelAnswer

PersonView.description: A demo person from config/people.toml (development identity, not an account).
PersonView.title: PersonView

PreviousDecision.description:
A person's decision (accepted or dismissed) on the finding an earlier version of the
same agent raised with the same (cut, kind, site, check).
PreviousDecision.title: PreviousDecision

QtlView.description: A study-level quality tolerance limit, as qtl_detector computes it.
QtlView.title: QtlView

QualityObservation.description:
A QA auditor's observation (phase 3 step 4b), attributed to the auditor. The same
write appends a qa_observation finding that names this observation_id.
QualityObservation.title: QualityObservation

ReconciliationItem.description:
One discrepancy: a current safety.sae_reconciler finding the caller may see, with
the two values it compares. subject_id is set only on subject-level findings, which
only the roles in their visible_to ever receive.
ReconciliationItem.title: ReconciliationItem

RedactedEvent.description: What a reader without unblinded access sees in place of a restricted event.
RedactedEvent.title: RedactedEvent

RunTrace.description: The run that raised the finding: its ActorWoke and ActorSuspended events.
RunTrace.title: RunTrace

SiteFlag.description: A current finding (newest version, not superseded, not retired) at this site.
SiteFlag.title: SiteFlag

SubstrateRun.description:
Where an Agent Substrate run happened (phase 4a step 2).

On ActorWoke it is the plan: the actor is named but not yet created (actor_uid and
worker_pod are null). On ActorSuspended it is what the control plane reported for the
actor just before it was deleted. The run never suspends: the only snapshot an actor
has is the golden snapshot it was created from (golden_snapshot).
SubstrateRun.title: SubstrateRun

TmfArtifact.description: One expected artifact of config/tmf_expected.toml (names only, no numbers).
TmfArtifact.title: TmfArtifact

TmfCell.description:
One artifact at one site (or the trial). For a visit report, expected counts the
visits that are due, filed those with a report, late those filed late.
TmfCell.title: TmfCell

TmfCompletenessView.description:
The TMF of one cut: completeness and timely filing per site and for the trial, the
expected-against-filed matrix (computed from the cut's eTMF index), and the current
quality.tmf_completeness findings the caller may see. No subject data.
TmfCompletenessView.title: TmfCompletenessView

UnblindedCases.description:
How many safety cases on the operational cut carry an unblinded treatment field.
Only the count: the treatment itself is never served.
UnblindedCases.title: UnblindedCases

info.description:
The Meridian Fleet API: read findings, narratives, the ledger and the fleet, and record
human decisions. Agents raise findings; people close them here. Nothing is ever updated
or deleted: a decision is an appended HumanDecision event.

**This is not real authentication.** Every request names a person in `X-Meridian-Actor`
and a role in `X-Meridian-Role`; the API only checks that config/people.toml lists that
person with that role. Anyone who can reach the port can claim any listed identity. Every
response carries `X-Meridian-Auth: development`. Development use only, on 127.0.0.1.
info.title: Meridian Fleet API

get.description:
Newest first (ledger seq descending). By default only operational cuts and no
superseded, retired or previously decided findings; widen with scope=all and the
include_ flags.

post.description:
Append one HumanDecision. 404 if the caller may not see the finding, 403 for
qa_auditor, 422 for a dismissal without a reason, 409 if already accepted or dismissed.

get.description: Liveness. The only route that needs no identity headers.

Events as the caller may see them (restricted ones redacted). order=asc (default):
after seq `since`, oldest first, continue with next_since. order=desc: newest first,
before seq `before` if given, continue with next_before. agent: only events the caller
may read in full whose payload names that agent (redacted events never match).

The demo people of config/people.toml, for the development role switcher. Needs no
identity headers: this is development identity, not sign-in.

schema.title: Response People Api V1 People Get

get.description:
The last audit trail review and the current audit findings (qa_auditor and
clinical_ops_lead only).
The QA observations the caller may see (qa_auditor, clinical_ops_lead, medical_monitor).

schema.title: Response Observations Api V1 Quality Observations Get

post.description:
QA auditor only: record an observation (a QualityObservation event and a
qa_observation finding raised by the auditor). A finding id or ledger seq it refers to
must exist and be visible to the auditor. Decided by clinical_ops_lead or
medical_monitor, never by the auditor who raised it.

get.description:
TMF completeness of one cut: completeness and timely filing per site and for the
trial, the expected-against-filed matrix, and the current quality.tmf_completeness
findings the caller may see. No subject data; the roles of the agent's config only.
Per-site metrics for the RBQM heatmap (clinical ops, medical monitor, QA only).

Open and escalated findings the caller may see, newest first. By default only
operational cuts (never evaluation cuts), and no superseded, retired or previously
decided findings (a person closed the same finding from an earlier agent version and
its primary evidence is unchanged).
Unblinded statistician only: how many cases carry a treatment field (a count).

SAE reconciliation of one cut: counts per check and site, and the discrepancies,
from the findings the caller may see. Subject-level findings reach only the roles in
their visible_to; for anyone else they are neither listed nor counted.
